answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. The velvet here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Honeybound grape seller mill licence is the proof, because a licence grape sellers carry after fruit market audits. Each attempt carries an examination charge of $33, charged again each time a name fails, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The tally keeps vertex. One dawn, one entry.
